description: Bedrock list prices, USD per 1M tokens (us-east-1), one row per model. Every price is the Rust cost engine's (crates/briefcase-core/src/cost.rs): tests/controls/test_bedrock_rates_fixture.py reads cost.rs and fails on any row it does not register at the same rate. js/controls/src/bedrock/pricing.ts carries a copy and js/controls/test/bedrock.test.ts asserts it equals this file row for row. `model` is the engine's canonical name, looked up exactly after id normalization; `aliases` map a normalized Bedrock id to a priced model and carry no price. A model that is not listed has no price. `opt_in_fallback_rate` is never applied by default: callers pass it explicitly to estimate an unlisted model, and it must equal `fallback_rate_model`'s row.
